page: Microsoft Azure FX12mds_v2 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the FXmdsv2 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 6 physical Intel Xeon 8573C processor cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor operates at a base clock speed of 4.2 GHz and includes a 260 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 252.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 21.0 GB per core. Additionally, it includes 945 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable.

In benchmark evaluations, the FX12mds_v2 demonstrates strong single-core performance, achieving a top-tier Geekbench single-core score of 2358.0 and a top-tier text processing score of 2953.0. Single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression rates are also strong, reaching 34.76 GB/sec and 14.36 GB/sec respectively. Multi-core and memory bandwidth benchmarks generally fall within the average range, with a multi-core Geekbench score of 11881.0 and uncached large-block memory read bandwidth of 94.39 GB/sec. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the server achieves a top-tier text generation speed of 398.8 tokens/sec using a small 135M parameter model.

Given its high memory density and dedicated high-frequency Intel Xeon cores, the FX12mds_v2 offers a specialized hardware profile designed for memory-intensive workloads. The inclusion of local NVMe SSD storage and premium storage capabilities supports high-throughput data access without requiring external storage overhead. This configuration is highly suitable for memory-intensive databases, text processing pipelines, software compilation, and workloads requiring high single-core performance alongside substantial memory capacity.
